column1: # pen-identity-cases.tsv — shared binary-identity table (Guard 2, plan Phase 1.7).
# Each row is run through BOTH resolvers against a fake package tree built under a temp HOME by
# plugins/soleur/test/lib/pen-identity-tree.mjs (the `layout` column names a key of its LAYOUTS
# export; there must be no row without a layout and no layout without a row):
#   - the adapter's `findPenBinary()`      -> adapter integration test (adapter column)
# The two columns agree on every row except where a note says otherwise; a row where they differ
# means one resolver accepts a binary the other refuses (Guard 2, mutation 4).
# Format: TAB-separated, one row per line, `#` lines and blank lines ignored. Five columns:
#   layout          name of a LAYOUTS entry in lib/pen-identity-tree.mjs
#   adapter         accept | refuse   expected verdict of findPenBinary() for $HOME=<tree>
#   check_deps      accept | refuse   expected verdict of detect_headless_cli for HOME=<tree>
#   legacy_warning  yes | no          whether a leftover @pencil.dev/cli warning is expected
# "accept" means the resolved binary is the installed @pen.dev/cli package's declared bin.pen target
# (realpath EQUAL to it, package name @pen.dev/cli, target inside the package directory, separator
# bounded). A package version other than the pin is accepted with a warning, never refused.
# <home>/fakebin, when the layout creates it, is prepended to PATH by the runner (no PATH fallback:
# a foreign `pen` there must never be selected).
